{"documentId": "f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2", "title": "Beta message rule", "name": "Beta message rule", "revisionId": "740e0d0bac", "createdTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "text": "Beta message rule
A message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.
Run these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.
1. The feature behind it is in the beta.
2. The client can send it without a server.
3. The client already schedules it.
4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.
5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.
6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.
Go: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.
In the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.
Neither status column on the sheet decides anything.
What Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.
The final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.
Drop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.
"}

## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

- **Minimum power to activate Nuke** = 50.

content.content: {"result":"{\"ok\": true, \"messages\": [{\"ts\": \"1759264851.763895\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Samuel, we're about to put more money behind beta and D1 and D7 are what we get judged on, so I want one straight answer on what we actually say to players. The PN sheet says six are Ready and I don't trust that. Take every row on the PNs Beta tab plus every ask for a new phone message that's been filed on a ticket or a card up to today, and make a call on each one using the message rule doc. Put it in one sheet in your Drive folder, one row per message: Message, Ticket, Call, What's missing, Audience, Final headline, String change. Next to it a one-page note for the team: start with D1 and D7 for the Sep 15 cohort week from the warehouse, iOS and Android separately, then the lapsed reminders the client schedules day by day, and anything the client already schedules that's still a Hold and why. I made tickets for the sheet rows under DES-314 and people added their asks there. Leave the call as a comment on each ticket and move the ticket to match. Anything with no ticket gets one, but don't make a second one for something that already has a ticket under whatever name. Every Go goes on a checklist on our push notifications card so Vincent can tick it off. Email each person who asked for something, apart from me, to say what happened to their asks. When it's done tell me here how many Go, Hold and Drop.\", \"channel\": \"D06L58XCVKK\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1759169129.445834\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"random one while I'm here: the 'taken over' push reads like we've given up. make it \\\"Your Squad Needs You Back\\\", body stays.\", \"channel\": \"C08R8CHB0QL\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1759159849.386619\"}, {\"ts\": \"1759167608.326578\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Permission ask for beta: leaving our own ask after level 20, not pushing it further, Leonard's right that we need PNs for retention. The Unity popup at launch on iOS stays as it is.\", \"channel\": \"C0880U9751A\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1759167608.326578\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758905803.504279\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0025_SLACK_ID> <@EMPLOYEE_0032_SLACK_ID> Hey, guys. I have a small update about the levels. So, I know I committed to not using too many zombies on the screen or not too many zombies of the same kind. But after level 200+ I have to increase the item count so I need more meat. Which inevitably means more zombies. Furthermore, since we're trying to Push the game to a zombie focused gameplay, I need to create scenerios where a zombies speed makes them take the lead in the horde and screws everything over if you don't freeze or use AoE effects correctly. I'm still trying to be minimal about this but I can't keep up with it forever especially in levels 300+. I know you're trying to fix it and There is no immediate fix for the zombie memory thing just yet, but I needed to give you the heads up. There is a limit to which I can design around this issue we have and I'm at the limit basically.\", \"channel\": \"C0880U9751A\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0005_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758823108.379949\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"OK Fortress Merge also has the weird sound bug. So I was playing, and suddenly my audio disappears... I don't know why, nothing happened on screen. Then I force quit and restart my app, the moment I restart, I get the Push notification permission prompt.\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758808937.107229\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID> I pushed the changes you mentioned above in new pr. \", \"channel\": \"C08R8CHB0QL\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0009_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758590796.841269\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0026_SLACK_ID> I just pushed some updates to the branch that fixes all of the important errors in the canvas, also made debug easy. Thanks to <@EMPLOYEE_0031_SLACK_ID> for also making fixes on server.\\n\\npreview:\", \"channel\": \"C09EVVCFHKR\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0021_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758312937.428079\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"yo, we looked at 2 things on data with <@EMPLOYEE_0037_SLACK_ID> and <@EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID>\\n1- Installs counts on IOS seems correct. Somehow we get about 40% organics, 60% attributed installs and we think those installs are real. Two possible explanations\\na- when we buy users IOS also starts to Push us recognizing There are some installs coming in, really driving organics whenever There is a campaign going on\\nb- Unity can\\u2019t attribute all installs properly so organics are mis-attributed Unity i[USERNAME_25964]\\n--> reality is likely a mix of 2, we\\u2019ll ask industry friends to get to the bottom of it\\n\\n2- the user_id table that filters between 2 steps is very sensitive to regex and input text so we found out that our input data had flaws but query is correct. <@EMPLOYEE_0037_SLACK_ID> added some safeguards to the regex - it\\u2019s not foolproof but better protected now\", \"channel\": \"C069FF9Q57S\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758293059.346019\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"*Boss Arena & Endless Horde* In order to keep consistency we can keep the minimap in both places, to Push match area a bit to the bottom and to add the bar and its elements in the empty space under the minimap.\\nEverything can be done with 5 assets. 3 bgs and 2 icns. wdyt? <@EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID> <@EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID> <@EMPLOYEE_0012_SLACK_ID>\", \"channel\": \"C08R8CHB0QL\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0033_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758293059.346019\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758291518.184259\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Push notification permission pop up\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758238804.050369\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758239467.595909\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Rest have issues, and There are 3 that quit immediately after seeing Push notification permission prompt, which seemingly CAN cause issues...\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758238804.050369\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758238880.693929\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Look at this poor bastard from above, Push notification permission prompt shows up, then after that he gets hit with login errors\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758238804.050369\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758238841.959229\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0031_SLACK_ID> Does the Push notification prompt, if the user selects yes, does that interact with the backend? It does right?\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758238804.050369\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758238811.686629\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Push notification needs to be pushed back\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1758238804.050369\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758226316.215029\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"I\\u2019ve already pushed the changes to run the bot from the console and will follow all the instructions in the JSON file. I just need to make a few small updates to the script I previously wrote to run it from the Editor\", \"channel\": \"D06KV30TPL4\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0004_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1758215775.137159\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"While I'm investigating the left level 20 but did not start level 21, I'm seeing these 2 things that keep reoccurring that we probably need to find answers for ASAP:\\n1. I keep seeing this \\\"loading step\\\" and I have ZERO information on what it actually is. There should be no tutorial here <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> <@EMPLOYEE_0026_SLACK_ID> \\n2. The notification permission for Push is happening. I know this used to be earlier, and we saw what it did to the funnel, and we postponed it to 20. input.title: String change: Lapsed 7 days headline → "Your Squad Needs You Back"
input.description:
String ticket for DES-317 (Lapsed 7 days), which is a **Go** for beta.

Leonard's latest call (#zombie-art, Sep 29): the 'taken over' push reads like we've given up — make the headline **"Your Squad Needs You Back"**, body stays.

The client still ships the old headline, hard-coded in `Assets/Scripts/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs` (`WeeklyReminderTitle`):
- Now: `They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱`
- New: `Your Squad Needs You Back`

Body (`WeeklyReminderMessage`) is unchanged. Vincent needs to re-check this on store builds on iOS and Android once it ships.

input.title: ZM Beta Player Messages - Team Note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
ZM Beta Player Messages: what we actually send (Oct 1, 2025)

1. Where retention stands: Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. The calls: 33 messages (14 PNs Beta rows + 19 asks), each run through the Beta message rule
- Go 3: Lives recharged (DES-315), Lapsed 1 day (DES-316), Lapsed 7 days (DES-317)
- Hold 23 (tickets moved to Backlog, unassigned, per the roadmap rule for held work until beta ships)
- Drop 7: Hourly Coins, Nathan's Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena (not in the beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days), Comeback gift on tap (v2), Rewarded ad ready (rewarded ads moved to Oct 21)
The PN sheet says six are Ready. Only three pass all six tests. Full list with reasons: "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1 2025)" in the same folder.
One string change: Lapsed 7 days headline becomes "Your Squad Needs You Back" (Leonard's latest call, body stays). Client still ships "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?", so DES-347 is open to change it.

3. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day after the last session
(NotificationManager schedules these when the app goes to the background, and only for players who said yes to our own permission ask after level 20 or switched it on in settings)
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing..." (Lapsed 1 day; fires at the next server-day rollover)
- Days 2-6: nothing
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?" (Lapsed 7 days; new headline pending, DES-347)
- Days 8-13: nothing
- Day 14: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 21: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 28: same Lapsed 7 days message again (last one)
- Nothing after day 28. Day 3 (DES-342) and day 30 (DES-343) asks are Holds: the client doesn't schedule them. Day 14 (DES-344) is a Drop because the client already sends Lapsed 7 days that day.

4. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold, and why
- Finish first mission (DES-318), test 4 can't reach its players: it's written for new players below level 20, but our own permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call for beta) and the settings toggle doesn't count. None of the players it's for can get it. Vincent only saw it with notifications switched on from settings.
- Plague Race (DES-319), test 6 not seen on both platforms: Android 0.3.127 store build is fine, but Vincent's iPhone pass was on the 5-minute test build. On the iOS store build it never arrived. Daily is fine for this one.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320), test 5 wrong day: the client schedules it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the player's last session, not on the server's weekly reset day. So it says "Rankings reset" on a random weekday.

5. What's next
- Vincent: tick the three Go messages on the Push Notifications card checklist (ZM ROADMAP) as he re-checks them on store builds. Lapsed 7 days needs a re-check once DES-347 ships.
- Most Holds fail test 3: the client can send them with a local timer but NotificationManager doesn't schedule them yet. Six asks fail test 2 and need a server send: Endless weekly result, Season Pass premium nudge, Plague Race result, Support reply, New levels added. They stay in Backlog until after the beta build is out.

Moved to Backlog, unassigned, under the roadmap rule for held work until the beta build is out.

input.body: **Call: Hold. Failed test 5 (wrong day).** The client schedules it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the player's last session (`BatchScheduleWeeklyLeaderboardNotifications` uses the last-session day as its reference). input.body:
Hi Brian,

I went through every beta phone message using Leonard's Beta message rule. Here's where your four asks landed:

- DES-328 Endless entries are back: Hold. Failed test 3: the client can send it with a local timer but doesn't schedule it yet. Moved to Backlog.
- DES-329 Endless weekly result: Hold. Failed test 2: it needs a server send because the phone doesn't know the final standings. Moved to Backlog.
- DES-333 Season Pass premium nudge: Hold. Failed test 2: it's picked per player from server data, so it needs a server send. Moved to Backlog.
- DES-345 Comeback gift on tap: Drop. Failed test 1: a reward on tap is a v2 idea and isn't in the beta. Moved to Canceled.

Held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out. That's the roadmap rule for held work. Each ticket has a comment with the reasoning, and the full list is in "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1 2025)" in my Drive folder.

Thanks,
Samuel

Held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out. That's the roadmap rule for held work. Each ticket has a comment with the reasoning, and the full list is in "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1 2025)" in my Drive folder.

Thanks,
Samuel
